description: This PHP file defines a class 'PayGrade' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It implements filtering logic for pay grade entities in report filters, including methods for constructing query conditions and converting pay grade data to array format.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: A class representing a filter field for pay grades in report generation, allowing for query construction and data transformation related to pay grades.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE clause to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is not null, filtering records by a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query context, in this case, 'salary'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the pay grade entity by ID and returns its ID and name as an array; returns null if not found.
